svg.title: Yosuljin — between worlds
svg.desc: Profile poster of Yosuljin — writer, photographer, creator, researcher, engineer, architect: “I build systems, images and worlds.” A night sky with the Chinese words 世界之間, “between worlds”. A vertical scale orders the projects from the farthest to the nearest: Rick, the farthest horizon, and Universe, where Constellation is the first direction, both greyed out; Sentience, where Aether is the only project for now; Worlds, where Frame, the video game, stands at the same weight as Aether, with Libera and this site. At the centre, the map of Aether at register D149: Lumina, the cognitive system — Lumens, ego, the conscious and her Sigil — with la lumina, furu and reminiscence; TheHive, her surface; AlmaS, her first agent, on Greffe and in Lucarne; Net and Lara in Miscellaneous, the web layer; Réseau to come; Temoin. On the planet below: four domains (development, photography, writing, worlds), what comes now (AlmaS, then Lumina), next and later. Butterflies and cherry petals; private details stay out of the picture.

g.text: DOSSIER 01 · THE ONLY ONE, FOR NOW
WRITER · PHOTOGRAPHER · CREATOR · RESEARCHER · ENGINEER · ARCHITECT
I build systems, images and worlds.
REGISTERED, OTHER HANDS · MEMORIA · ACROPOLIS · SAKAKI · ALMA-SHELL · ARDUPILOT-FPV-GAME
An absence is not a non-existence.
